mapper.sql: select id, document_id, business_type, business_id, relation_type, create_by from kb_object_link
mapper.insert: insert into kb_object_link ( document_id, business_type, business_id, relation_type, create_by ) values ( #{documentId}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{relationType}, #{createBy} )
mapper.select: select id, document_id, business_type, business_id, relation_type, create_by, create_time from kb_object_link where business_type = #{businessType} and business_id = #{businessId} order by id
select id, document_id, business_type, business_id, relation_type, create_by, create_time from kb_object_link where document_id = #{documentId} order by id
